name: Regenerative Aura
body:
Discipline: psychometabolism (Healing); Level: vitalist 9, egoist 9

CASTING

Display: material, visual
Manifesting Time: 1 standard action

EFFECT

Range: 30 ft
Area: 30 ft. radius sphere centered on you
Duration: 1 round/lvl. (D)
Saving Throw: Fort negates (harmless); Power Resistance: Yes (harmless)
Power Points: 17

DESCRIPTION

Psionic power radiates out from your body, causing all living creatures within range to rapidly heal as their healing ability is hyperaccelerated. All living creatures within range heal 25 hit points per round.

Augment: By expending your psionic focus while manifesting this power, you may select which creatures are healed.
